title: COMMUNICATION FROM THE CITY ENGINEER relative to the final map of Parcel Map L.A. No. 2025-1576, located at 1924 Federal Avenue, southerly of Missouri Avenue.
text:
[Council File 26-1522; CD 11]
[Items for which Public Hearings Have Not Been Held - (10 Votes Required for Consideration)]
COMMUNICATION FROM THE CITY ENGINEER relative to the final map of Parcel Map L.A. No. 2025-1576, located at 1924 Federal Avenue, southerly of Missouri Avenue.
Recommendation for Council action:
APPROVE the final map of Parcel Map L.A. No. 2025-1576, located at 924 Federal Avenue, southerly of Missouri Avenue and accompanying Subdivision Improvement Agreement and Contract with security documents.
Owner: Shahram J Koma SK Trust (O)(A); Surveyor: Nick Kazemi
Fiscal Impact Statement:
The City Engineer reports that the subdivider has paid a fee of $16,500 for the processing of this final parcel map pursuant to Section 19.02(B)(3) of the Los Angeles Municipal Code. No additional City funds are needed.
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted.
